## ContainedProcess

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.ProcessIsolation.ContainedProcess</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.ProcessIsolation/ContainedProcess.cs:58](../../../../src/Meridian.ProcessIsolation/ContainedProcess.cs#L58).

Owns a child process and the smallest reusable containment boundary needed by untrusted-workload clients. Windows children are assigned to a kill-on-close Job Object; other platforms use the runtime&#x27;s recursive process-tree termination support.

```csharp
public sealed class ContainedProcess : IAsyncDisposable, IDisposable
```

## ContainedProcessLimits

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.ProcessIsolation.ContainedProcessLimits</code>. Kind: `record`.

Source: [src/Meridian.ProcessIsolation/ContainedProcess.cs:13](../../../../src/Meridian.ProcessIsolation/ContainedProcess.cs#L13).

Resource ceilings applied to a contained process tree. Windows Job Objects enforce all three ceilings in the kernel. Other platforms retain recursive lifecycle containment and aggregate observation, but cannot claim the same hard-limit guarantee through this component.

```csharp
public sealed record ContainedProcessLimits(long MaxAggregateMemoryBytes, TimeSpan MaxAggregateCpuTime, int MaxActiveProcesses, bool RequireHardLimits = false)
```
